tour.title: Ban Do Du An
tour.description: Bat dau tu AGENTS.md vi day la source of truth cho repo nay. Tai lieu nay giai thich module nao quan trong, debug flow nao thi mo file nao truoc, va cac ranh gioi OCR AI so voi OCR local. Khi nam duoc ban do nay, phan con lai cua codebase de doc hon rat nhieu.

tour.title: Khoi Dong Ung Dung
tour.description: main.py la diem vao runtime cua web app. Tai day ung dung nap moi truong, mount static va templates, chay migration nhe, dang ky routers va warmup OCR local truoc khi nhan request. Doc file nay cho ban cai nhin tong quat backend duoc ghep nhu the nao.

tour.title: Du Lieu Cot Loi
tour.description: database.py va models.py xac dinh nen persistence cua he thong. Chinh tai day cac bang Customer, Property, InheritanceCase, OCRJob va cac lien ket nghiep vu duoc khai bao, dong thoi migration nhe giu SQLite theo kip contract hien tai. Day la lop ma gan nhu moi router deu phu thuoc.

tour.title: Ho So Va Giao Dien
tour.description: routers/cases.py va cases/form.html tao thanh trung tam nghiep vu cua san pham. Router xu ly form, preview, export Word va payload so do; template thi ket noi OCR AI, OCR local, pool khach hang va toan bo thao tac tren mot man hinh duy nhat. ReactFlowApp.jsx bo sung lop tuong tac phia client cho so do quan he.
tour.languageLesson: Jinja2 template trong du an nay khong chi render HTML tinh; no dong vai tro shell cho rat nhieu script browser va hook OCR, nen mot template co the la diem hoi tu cua ca backend lẫn frontend state.

tour.title: OCR AI Cloud
tour.description: routers/ocr_ai.py la nhanh OCR uu tien latency. File nay ket hop QR server raw_only, native OCR cua model cloud va logic parse/pairing de tra JSON CCCD hoac giay to tai san theo contract cua man hinh ho so. docs/plans/ocr_ai.md giu lai quyet dinh thiet ke va boundary can ton trong khi sua luong nay.
tour.languageLesson: Pipeline OCR AI o day tach ro ba viec: doc text, suy field, va pair anh. Viec giu parser o backend giup thay model cloud hoac QR strategy ma khong vo contract JSON o UI.

tour.title: OCR Local Worker
tour.description: routers/ocr_local.py la pipeline nghien cuu va do chinh xac, con tasks.py dua no vao job bat dong bo qua Celery. Day la noi triage, crop, QR rescue va deterministic merge duoc hien thuc, trong khi docs/plans/ocr_local.md giai thich tai sao local flow duoc giu doc lap voi OCR AI. Neu can debug batch OCR that, day la cum file phai vao som.
tour.languageLesson: Celery trong repo nay khong tu viet OCR; worker chi dong vai tro adapter doc file tam, goi ham OCR local, roi persist ket qua. Cach tach nay giu duoc logic OCR o mot noi duy nhat de debug.

tour.title: CRUD Nghiep Vu
tour.description: routers/customers.py, routers/properties.py va routers/participants.py bao phu cac thao tac CRUD bo tro cho ho so thua ke. Nhom file nay cho thay cach du an pha vo domain lon thanh cac router nho hon, trong do import Excel khach hang va inline create la hai duong vao quan trong cho du lieu nguoi tham gia.

tour.title: Logic Sơ Do Phia Client
tour.description: inheritance_engine.js, diagram_state.js va diagram_edges.js gom thanh bo may cua so do quan he thua ke tren trinh duyet. Day la phan giai quyet registry, edge rules va state transition ma template cases/form.html dua vao de dong bo giao dien voi payload backend. Neu user than ve keo tha, xoa node hay state diagram, cum nay la noi can doc.

tour.title: Cua Chan Chat Luong
tour.description: He thong test va verify khong nam o mot file duy nhat ma la mot bo cua chan. test_diagram_payload_parser.py khoa contract giua form va router cases, con verify.ps1 la wrapper thuc thi compile, lint va test OCR dung luc. Nhom nay cho thay du an uu tien giu hanh vi nghiep vu dung truoc khi toi uu code dep.

tour.title: Van Hanh Va Template
tour.description: run.bat va script deploy VPS cho thay cach ung dung duoc khoi dong ngoai local workstation. Song song, cac word template va placeholder mapping cho thay output cuoi cung cua nghiep vu khong dung lai o JSON ma di den van ban cong chung co cau truc. Day la diem noi giua engineering workflow va tai lieu ban giao cho nguoi dung cuoi.
